findings.body: The strict path rejects only exit code 2 or the literal `review_status: incomplete`. A zero-exit report with `findings: []` and a missing or unknown review status passes this check; with matching model and effort telemetry, `decision accept` then records the reviewed commit. Require an affirmative finished status before accepting sign-off.

findings.body: The command tests refuse `review_status: incomplete` and exit code 2, but never try a zero-exit report with a missing or unknown status. That case currently accepts, so these tests do not guard the strict completion requirement. The successful fixtures also use `complete`, while the existing Autoreview fixture in `tests/test_close.py:67-72` uses `scoped-clean`; test an actual successful status as well.
